title: Castle Inspection

dmosLevelConversion.reason: The source specifies no level. Full crisis extraction and D&D conversion QA are required before a recommended level is published.

hardCanon: The player characters are undead heroes summoned by the lich Radagast.
Imperial Insurance Inspector Ignatius the Intransigent arrives for an unannounced inspection.
Ignatius searches for insurance violations that can increase Radagast's policy cost.
Multiple castle crises are already active when the adventure begins.
The AI DM must not invent permanent castle geography until the source map is fully extracted.
